import copy, json
from work import evaluate
request={'claim':'limit','conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None}}
evidence=[
 {'source':'z-old','claim':'limit','value':9,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True},
 {'source':'b-new','claim':'limit','value':2,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True,'supersedes':['z-old']},
 {'source':'a-1','claim':'limit','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True},
 {'source':'a-2','claim':'limit','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True},
 {'source':'u','claim':'limit','value':2,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':False,'supersedes':['a-1']},
 {'source':'w','claim':'limit','value':2,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True}
]
policy={'required_conditions':['mode','calibration'],'require_verified':True}
before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
expected={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a-1','a-2','b-new'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}
assert got==expected,(got,expected)
assert (request,evidence,policy)==before
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: fixture_evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: fixture_policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,fixture_evidence,fixture_policy) for r in requests]
print(json.dumps({'boundary':got,'report':report},sort_keys=True))
